Patch release for Docker installs: 0.17.0 could not sign anyone in after an upgrade on Docker.

> [!NOTE]
> **Docker:** upgrade with the usual commands (`git checkout v0.17.1`, `build`, `stop scheduler workers fastlane ws`, `up -d`). Your backup archives stay where they are. Bare-metal and bundle installs are not affected by the bug; 0.17.1 changes nothing for them.

### Fixed

- #332 - **Docker: every request answered 500 after upgrading to 0.17.0, `/api/me` first, so nobody could sign in.** The `backups` volume was mounted at `/app/backups`, which is also the folder of Danbyte's own backups code. Docker fills a named volume from the image only when the volume is created, so the containers kept running the backups code of the release that first made the volume, and 0.17.0's request handling needs code that copy did not have. The volume now mounts at `/app/backup-archives`; a migration moves the Local backup target with it, so existing archives keep working. A test refuses any compose volume mounted over code.
- An empty `CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` in the environment no longer stops Danbyte from starting.
